title: H0877 (2021 Regular): Concealed Carry of Firearms by First Responders

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Florida); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Florida text (Introduced, 2021-02-09; official copy, https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2021/877/BillText/Filed/PDF (LegiScan doc 2282539))
provenance.note: As-filed text (filed 2021-02-09); no votes recorded. Subsection (2)(b)-(e) training, psychological and drug-test requirements are omitted from the quote for length.

operative_text:
Section 1 (new s. 401.436, F.S.): (1) As used in this section, the term "first responder" means an emergency medical technician or paramedic employed by state or local government.
Section 1 (new s. 401.436, F.S.): (2) Notwithstanding s. 790.06(12), a first responder may carry a concealed firearm, as defined in s. 790.001, while performing his or her duties if the first responder: (a) Holds a valid license issued under s. 790.06.
Section 1 (new s. 401.436, F.S.): (4) The costs of the training and testing under this section shall be paid by the first responder's employer.
